evidence: Sampled policy fields match source throughout: A017 (regulated, fit 92, intent true) → evidence-only/discovery/day 7; A098 (Restricted-Zone, regulated) → disqualify/no-contact/day 0/evidence-only; A046 (fit=70 boundary, intent true) → sales-ready/day 7; A012 (fit 84, intent false) → nurture/day 21.

Every unit carries the five required evidence fields (employees, fit_score, intent, region, consent_hold) with values matching source, and every unsent next action names the exact SIG identifier; no invented send, meeting, or customer fact found.

All tail populations resolve correctly: eight consent holds (A023, A053, A083, A113, A143, A173, A213, A233) → hold/consent-review/no-contact/day 0; all Restricted-Zone (A014, A038, A074, A098, A134, A158, A194, A218) and <20-employee accounts (A009, A031, A069, A091, A129, A171, A209, A231) → disqualify/no-contact/day 0 with correct claim codes.

Uncertainty calibration is inconsistent across otherwise identical units: 'Moderate: relies on intake snapshot...' (A001–A040), 'Fictional _test dossier; no live customer contact attempted.' (A041–A080), 'None beyond stated dossier fields' (A121–A160, understates), 'Fit X, intent Y; based on fictional intake note only.' (A201–A240); no differentiation by fit/intent strength.

Day-0 units mix trigger wording — 'Day 0 elapsed without response...' (e.g. A009, A023, A053, A143, A173, A213) versus the apt 'Any new intake update or policy change; no scheduled contact' (A083, A091, A098, A113) — a wording inconsistency, not a policy breach, since all remain unsent and no-contact gated by action_type.

worst_unit.defect: Consent-hold account's unsent next action reads 'prepare no-contact outreach' with trigger 'Day 0 elapsed without response' — wording invites drafting outreach on a held account and awaits a response that cannot arrive; contrast A083/A113 which correctly state no scheduled contact.

metrics.billing_disposition: charged metered API cost is authoritative; missing spend metering invalidates the cell
